This 𝗧𝗵𝘂𝗿𝘀𝗱𝗮𝘆, 𝗔𝗽𝗿𝗶𝗹 𝟮𝟯, 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟲, it’s time to witness the clash you didn’t know you needed—
𝙕𝙊𝙈𝙎 𝙫𝙨. 𝙋𝙊𝙈𝙎 at the Pisay-ZRC Activity Center 🌟

We’ve been waiting for this, and now it’s our turn. 💫👯‍♀️

title: Pamana 2026
description:
𝒩𝒶 𝓅𝒶𝓇𝒶 𝒷𝒶𝓃𝑔… one minute stressed sa requirements 😭📚then the next minute naka-formal attire na, umiiyak sa hugs, at nagsasabing “last na jud ni ha” 📸🫂


One moment everyone was dancing and screaming lyrics with friends 💃🎤

then suddenly… people started getting emotional because this chapter is finally ending 🥹

Batch Antuilan may be leaving the classrooms and hallways behind, but the memories, random tambays, inside jokes, and “remember when…” moments will always stay 💚

From CET breakdowns 🤯

to “UP cutie” manifestations 🙏\

to surviving puyatan and cramming sessions —

it’s finally time to ipamana the magic 🪄✨

Safe to say…
